dependence_group: seed shared across both plants, worlds and policy variants
unit: Worst required/published additional physical-disc radius over all eligible acquisitions and all five horizons within each seed group
scoring_domain: First published forecast for each track acquisition; require eight seconds of complete recorded follow-up before scoring any horizon
unmatched_and_absent: Infinite score; include eligible origins in coverage denominators
right_censoring: Count and report late origins; never label them covered
acceptance: All 48 retained cases and original per-horizon coverage must be reproduced byte/provenance-wise. No finite calibrated confidence claim is authorized by this retrospective cohort.
limits: Order-statistic calculation alone does not establish exchangeability. A 99% finite rank needs at least 99 independent calibration groups; physical safety and measured-data calibration remain unverified.
